Pinout

       DIP24-600mil
         +--\/--+
     Vss |1   24| *CTS
 Rx DATA |2   23| *DCD
  Rx CLK |3   22| D0
  Tx CLK |4   21| D1
    *RTS |5   20| D2
 Tx DATA |6   19| D3
    *IRQ |7   18| D4
     CS0 |8   17| D5
    *CS2 |9   16| D6
     CS1 |10  15| D7
      RS |11  14| E
     Vcc |12  13| R/*W
         +------+

Frequency

Set reader to FREQ, put black probe to GND, red probe to 3,4 to measure CPU clock
